camel_example: aliyun ecs ModifyAutoProvisioningGroup --region cn-hangzhou --TotalTargetCapacity 70 --AutoProvisioningGroupName 'apg-test' --ExcessCapacityTerminationPolicy 'no-termination' --LaunchTemplateConfig.1.InstanceType 'ecs.g5.large' --LaunchTemplateConfig.1.WeightedCapacity '2.0' --PayAsYouGoTargetCapacity 30 --TerminateInstancesWithExpiration false --DefaultTargetCapacityType Spot --LaunchTemplateConfig.1.MaxPrice '3.0' --SpotTargetCapacity 30 --AutoProvisioningGroupId 'apg-bp67acfmxazb4ph0000' --MaxSpotPrice '0.5' --LaunchTemplateConfig.1.Priority 1 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --LaunchTemplateConfig.1.VSwitchId 'vsw-sn5bsitu4lfzgc5o70000'
description_en: Modifies the configurations of an auto provisioning group
description_zh: 修改一个弹性供应组的配置信息
kebab_example: aliyun ecs modify-auto-provisioning-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --auto-provisioning-group-id apg-bp67acfmxazb4ph0000 --excess-capacity-termination-policy no-termination --default-target-capacity-type Spot --terminate-instances-with-expiration false --max-spot-price 0.5 --total-target-capacity 70 --pay-as-you-go-target-capacity 30 --spot-target-capacity 30 --auto-provisioning-group-name apg-test --launch-template-config WeightedCapacity=2.0 Priority=1 VSwitchId=vsw-sn5bsitu4lfzgc5o70000 MaxPrice=3.0 InstanceType=ecs.g5.large --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyAutoProvisioningGroup

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the auto provisioning group. You can invoke https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 弹性供应组所在地域的ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the auto provisioning group
parameters.name: auto_provisioning_group_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to release instances when the real-time capacity of the auto provisioning group exceeds the target capacity and a scale-in event is triggered. Valid values:

termination: Releases the scaled-in instances.
no-termination: Only removes the scaled-in instances from the auto provisioning group
parameters.help_zh:
弹性供应组实时容量超过目标容量并触发缩容时，是否释放缩容的实例。取值范围：

termination：释放缩容的实例。
no-termination：只将缩容的实例移出弹性供应组
parameters.name: excess_capacity_termination_policy

parameters.help_en:
The billing method of the capacity difference when the sum of PayAsYouGoTargetCapacity and SpotTargetCapacity is less than TotalTargetCapacity. Valid values:

PayAsYouGo: pay-as-you-go instance.
Spot: spot instance
parameters.help_zh:
PayAsYouGoTargetCapacity和SpotTargetCapacity之和小于TotalTargetCapacity时，指定差额容量的计费方式。取值范围：

PayAsYouGo：按量付费实例。
Spot：抢占式实例
parameters.name: default_target_capacity_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to release instances in the auto provisioning group when the group expires. Valid values:

true: Releases the instances in the group.
false: Only removes the instances from the auto provisioning group
parameters.help_zh:
弹性供应组到期时，是否释放组内实例。取值范围：

true：释放组内实例。
false：只将组内实例移出弹性供应组
parameters.name: terminate_instances_with_expiration

parameters.help_en:
The maximum price of spot instances in the auto provisioning group.

If both MaxSpotPrice and LaunchTemplateConfig.N.MaxPrice are specified, the lower value is used. LaunchTemplateConfig.N.MaxPrice is specified in Settings when the auto provisioning group is created and cannot be modified
parameters.help_zh:
弹性供应组内抢占式实例的最高价格。

同时设置了MaxSpotPrice和LaunchTemplateConfig.N.MaxPrice时，以最低值为准。LaunchTemplateConfig.N.MaxPrice在创建弹性供应组时设置，且不可修改
parameters.name: max_spot_price

parameters.help_en:
The total target capacity of the auto provisioning group. Valid values: positive integers.

The total capacity must be greater than or equal to the sum of PayAsYouGoTargetCapacity (the target capacity of pay-as-you-go instances) and SpotTargetCapacity (the target capacity of spot instances)
parameters.help_zh:
弹性供应组的目标总容量。取值范围：正整数。

总容量必须大于等于PayAsYouGoTargetCapacity（指定的按量付费实例目标容量）和SpotTargetCapacity（指定的抢占式实例目标容量）取值之和
parameters.name: total_target_capacity

parameters.help_en: The target capacity of pay-as-you-go instances in the auto provisioning group. Valid values: less than the parameter value of TotalTargetCapacity
parameters.help_zh: 弹性供应组内，按量付费实例的目标容量。取值范围：小于TotalTargetCapacity的参数取值
parameters.name: pay_as_you_go_target_capacity

parameters.help_en: The target capacity of spot instances in the auto provisioning group. Valid values: less than the parameter value of TotalTargetCapacity
parameters.help_zh: 弹性供应组内，抢占式实例的目标容量。取值范围：小于TotalTargetCapacity的参数取值
parameters.name: spot_target_capacity

parameters.help_en: The name of the auto provisioning group. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character and cannot start with http:// or https://. The name can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (_), or hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 弹性供应组的名称。长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以http://和https://开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者连字符（-）
parameters.name: auto_provisioning_group_name

fields.help_en: The instance type specified in the extension launch template. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25378.html
fields.help_zh: 扩展启动模板对应的实例规格，N的取值范围：1~20。取值范围：请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25378.html
fields.name: instance_type

fields.help_en: The maximum price of the spot instance in the extended launch template
fields.help_zh: 扩展启动模板中，抢占式实例的价格上限
fields.name: max_price

fields.help_en: The priority of the extended launch template. A value of 0 indicates the highest priority. Valid values: greater than 0
fields.help_zh: 扩展启动模板的优先级，取值为0时优先级最高。取值范围：大于0
fields.name: priority

fields.help_en: The ID of the vSwitch to which the ECS instance belongs in the extended launch template. The zone of the ECS instance launched from the extended template is determined by the vSwitch
fields.help_zh: 扩展启动模板中，ECS实例加入的虚拟交换机的ID。扩展模板中启动的ECS实例的可用区由虚拟交换机决定
fields.name: vswitch_id

fields.help_en:
The weight of the instance type specified in the extended launch template. A higher value indicates that a single instance can meet more computing requirements, which means fewer instances are required. Valid values: greater than 0.

You can calculate the weight based on the computing power of the specified instance type and the minimum computing power of a single node in the cluster. For example, if the minimum computing power of a single node is 8 vCPUs and 60 GiB:

The weight of an instance type with 8 vCPUs and 60 GiB can be set to 1.
The weight of an instance type with 16 vCPUs and 120 GiB can be set to 2
fields.help_zh:
扩展启动模板中，实例规格的权重。取值越高，单台实例满足计算力需求的能力越大，所需的实例数量越小。取值范围：大于0。

您可以根据指定实例规格的计算力和集群单节点最低计算力得出权重值。假设单节点最低计算力为8 vCPU、60 GiB，则：

8 vCPU、60 GiB的实例规格权重可以设置为1。
16 vCPU、120 GiB的实例规格权重可以设置为2
fields.name: weighted_capacity
